violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 25 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Sanitizer container was replaced during time of inspection and read at 50 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2026

Milk was observed held at 46-50 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were assessed; time/ temperature abused foods were voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2026

2 door reach-in was observed at an ambient of 48 degrees Fahrenheit. Temperature display of unit was observed at 40 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit was taken out of service during time of inspection to hold foods that require refrigeration for food safety. Refrigerator to be properly adjusted, repaired, and/or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 08/14/2026

Steam table is in poor repair. Unit was out of service prior to inspection. Facility is using other methods to maintain temperature control for hot foods. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2026
Glass door on chest freezer was observed cracked. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2025

The following areas were observed in poor repair: -walls (exposed wood), wall caps (misaligned) and coving (missing) by cookline -lined box under dish machine near The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/02/2026

The ceiling in the walk-in freezer used for storage is in poor repair (peeling observed in various spots). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2025
Glass door on chest freezer was observed cracked. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the chest freezers have an accumulation of ice. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2025

The ceiling in the walk-in freezer used for storage is in poor repair (peeling observed in various spots). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Can opener was cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Slicer was observed with food debris, nicks and rust on blade and sharpener. Slicer was taken out of service during time of inspection. Slicer must be repaired/refurbished/ replaced prior to use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2024

The door to the outside, located by the dumpster, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the storage room shelving have an accumulation of soil residue and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2024
The 2 bay prep sink is lacking a proper air gap. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2024

The following was observed in poor repair: 1. Coving by the prep sink (COB: 08/05/2024) 2. Walls by door frame in the back storage room (COB: 08/05/2024) 3. Wall fixture by dishmachine (COB: 08/05/2024) 4. Floor tiles by the dishwashing machine (COB: 07/22/2025) The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2025
